assistance_default.rule: Any task element completed through human assistance is scored as zero points, unless explicitly stated otherwise in the task description.

requirements: Robot must clearly and explicitly request assistance
Request must specify type of assistance and intended outcome
Robot must supervise and verify the outcome, not assume success

assistance_budget.rule: From the second human assistance request onwards, repeated or excessive requests without demonstrating autonomous action may lead the referee to immediately stop the task.
assistance_budget.note: Cross-cutting sequence constraint; cannot be expressed per-entry.

disqualifying_global.description: Major, grossly negligent collision; TC may disqualify for test or competition
Robot removed from Arena after 30 s of inactivity
